description: Built 31-10-2026 from VATSIM UK's EGCC vMATS Part 2 (Revision 2026/05), the authoritative source; the MAG 'Manchester Airport Runway Use Information Pack' corroborates only, and vMATS wins wherever the two differ (owner decision this session). Mode ids are runway-coded, matching the project's usual form: 05LAD/23RAD for single-runway mixed mode (as YSSY's 07AD/25AD), 05RA05LD/23RA23LD for segregated dual mode (as LSZH's 14A28D). No per-mode maxCrosswindKt: 05L/23R and 05R/23L are parallel pairs sharing one heading each, so crosswind doesn't differ by which runway in a pair is active -- falls back to defaultCrosswindKt. No per-mode capacity: unresearched. Deliberately NOT modelled: a forced-single-runway-on-05R/23L mode for 05L/23R maintenance nights -- docs/TIME_BASED_RULES.md (OD-19) puts closures out of scope, and vMATS only says the real closure follows 'a variable schedule', not a fixed rule. Full detail: docs/EGCC_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md.

modes.description: Single-runway default, easterly: 05L arrivals and departures (vMATS GEN 5.2.2).
Single-runway default, westerly: 23R arrivals and departures (vMATS GEN 5.2.2). Preferred over 05LAD when the tailwind component is 5 kt or less and the runway is dry (vMATS GEN 5.1).
Dual segregated, easterly: arrivals 05R, departures 05L (vMATS GEN 5.2.1). Forbidden 22:00-06:00 local (operating_plan.json) -- 05R/23L is not available in real-world hours.
Dual segregated, westerly: arrivals 23R, departures 23L (vMATS GEN 5.2.1). Forbidden 22:00-06:00 local (operating_plan.json) -- 05R/23L is not available in real-world hours.

atisWording.source: project default -- no EGCC ATIS phrasing template was found in either the MAG pack or vMATS (vMATS GEN 3.4 only gives the ATIS frequency and responsibility, not its wording); kept for schema compatibility only
